sql: WITH e AS ( SELECT recorded_at::date AS day, live_tag, live_outcome, count(*) AS n FROM live_paper_parity_events WHERE recorded_at >= now() - interval '336 hours' AND live_tag IN ('Cmmsell10','Dmmsell10','Emmsell10','Fmmsell10') GROUP BY 1,2,3 ), open_ct AS ( SELECT strategy, created_at::date AS day, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='resting') AS resting_now, count(*) AS orders_created, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='filled') AS filled FROM live_orders WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '336 hours' AND strategy IN ('Cmmsell10','Dmmsell10','Emmsell10','Fmmsell10') GROUP BY 1,2 ) SELECT 'parity' AS src, day::text, live_tag AS tag, live_outcome AS k, n, NULL::bigint AS v2 FROM e WHERE live_outcome LIKE 'gate:%' OR live_outcome IN ('placed','rejected') UNION ALL SELECT 'orders', day::text, strategy, 'created/filled', orders_created, filled FROM open_ct ORDER BY 1,2,3,4
